context.transcript:
Looking for ways to get into better shape this year?
Why not join Nelson's Gym?
We have all the sports and exercise equipment you could need.
There's no need to make an appointment.
Stop by any of our locations between 12 noon and 3 p.m. and one of our fitness experts will give you a personalized tour of the facility.
And if two people sign up together, you'll both get 15% off your annual membership fees.
So bring a friend and register today.
context.transcript_translation:
今年想找到改善体型的方法吗？
为什么不加入 Nelson's Gym 呢？
我们拥有您可能需要的各种运动和健身器材。
无需预约。
请在中午 12 点到下午 3 点之间光临我们的任何一个地点，我们的健身专家会为您提供一次个性化的设施参观。
如果两个人一起注册，你们两人都能享受年度会员费 15% 的折扣。
所以带上朋友今天就来注册吧。
